title: Add integration test for OpenAPI generator compatibility
description: According to the http-client spec, scenario 'Integration with generated API client': The configured Dio instance should be compatible with openapi-generated client constructors without modification. Need an integration test that: (1) Uses a real openapi-generated client (or minimal mock), (2) Passes the ACDC-configured Dio instance to the client constructor, (3) Verifies the client accepts it without errors, (4) Makes a sample API call through the generated client, (5) Verifies all interceptors function correctly with the generated code. This ensures the builder returns a standard Dio instance (not a wrapper) that maintains full ecosystem compatibility.

title: Add test for cancelRefresh stopping in-progress refresh
description: The test 'cancelRefresh can be called to cancel in-progress refresh' was simplified to just call the method. Need to add proper test that verifies: 1) starting a refresh, 2) canceling it mid-flight, 3) verifying the refresh completer gets an error and queued requests are properly handled.

title: Achieve 80%+ code coverage
description:
Achieved 70.17% coverage (up from 62.73%). Created comprehensive tests for AcdcAuthManager (14 tests) and AuthInterceptor (22 tests). Refactored AuthInterceptor and AcdcAuthManager to support dependency injection for better testability. 

Remaining work to reach 80% tracked in dependencies:
- OAuth refresh HTTP calls need integration tests or more sophisticated mocking
- Token revocation HTTP calls need similar approach  
- Several edge cases identified and tracked in sub-tasks

Key achievement: Code is now much more testable with proper DI pattern. The 8 sub-tasks provide clear roadmap to 80%.

title: Respect ETag header in cache behavior
description: Modify the caching mechanism to respect the ETag HTTP header. When a response contains an ETag, it should be stored. Subsequent requests for the same resource should include the If-None-Match header with the stored ETag. If the server returns 304 Not Modified, the cached response should be used. If 200 OK is returned, the cache should be updated.

title: Refactor AuthInterceptor: Create OAuthTokenRefreshStrategy
description: Create lib/src/auth/oauth_token_refresh_strategy.dart by extracting OAuth 2.1 protocol logic (lines 326-422) from AuthInterceptor. Create comprehensive tests for OAuth error handling, token parsing, server time handling. Integrate and remove old methods.

title: Add test for non-standard HTTP status codes
description: According to the error-handling spec, scenario 'Non-standard status codes': When non-standard status codes are received (e.g., 418 I'm a teapot, 451 Unavailable For Legal Reasons, 599), they should be categorized by status code range: 4xx → AcdcClientException, 5xx → AcdcServerException, Other → AcdcClientException (fallback). The message should include 'Unexpected status code {code}: {reason}'. This test is currently missing.

title: Add test for OAuth 2.1 refresh request format and parameters
description: According to the authentication spec, scenario 'Refresh request construction': Token refresh requests should be POST to the refresh endpoint with application/x-www-form-urlencoded content type and include: (1) grant_type=refresh_token (required), (2) refresh_token=<token> (required), (3) client_id=<configured-client-id> (required). Should NOT include client_secret (mobile apps are public clients). A FakeOAuthServer helper exists in test/helpers/ but isn't currently used. Need a test that verifies these exact parameters are sent correctly.

title: Refactor AuthInterceptor: Create TokenRefreshStrategy interface
description: Create lib/src/auth/token_refresh_strategy.dart interface and lib/src/auth/custom_token_refresh_strategy.dart wrapper. Create tests and integrate strategy pattern into AuthInterceptor.

title: Add OAuth error response handling tests
description: The test 'handles invalid_grant error' is currently just a placeholder. Need to add tests with HTTP mocking (nock/mockito) for OAuth error responses: invalid_grant, invalid_client, unauthorized_client, unsupported_grant_type. Verify error messages are mapped correctly and tokens are cleared appropriately.

title: Add test for 3xx redirect handling
description: According to the error-handling spec, scenario '3xx redirect handling': When a redirect response (301, 302, 307, 308) is received AND Dio's automatic redirect following is disabled, an AcdcClientException should be thrown with message 'Unexpected redirect to {location}'. When automatic redirects are enabled (default), no exception should be thrown. This test is currently missing.

title: Configure code coverage for tests
description: Set up code coverage reporting for dart tests. Generate coverage reports and configure coverage thresholds. This will help track test coverage and ensure quality standards.

title: Add test for malformed/invalid response handling
description: According to the error-handling spec, scenario 'Malformed response handling': When a response cannot be parsed (invalid JSON, corrupted data), an AcdcClientException should be thrown with message 'Invalid response format from server' and the raw response body included (truncated to 1KB). This test is currently missing.

title: Add test for complete interceptor chain order
description: According to the http-client spec, scenarios 'Request interceptor order' and 'Response interceptor order': The builder should configure interceptors in a specific order. Request phase: Logging → Auth → Cache. Response phase: Cache → Auth → Error → Logging. Currently only a partial test exists that checks custom interceptors are after error interceptor. Need a comprehensive test that verifies the full chain order when all features are enabled (auth, cache, logging, error, custom). Note: Cache and Logging interceptors have TODOs in builder code (lines 623-624), so this test should be created when those are implemented.

title: Refactor AuthInterceptor: Create BackoffManager
description: Create lib/src/auth/backoff_manager.dart to manage exponential backoff state and timing. Extract backoff logic from AuthInterceptor. Create tests and integrate.

title: Add test for custom refresh function being invoked during token refresh
description: According to the authentication spec, scenario 'Custom refresh logic': Developers can provide a custom refresh function via withCustomTokenRefresh() for non-standard refresh logic. Currently, there's only a constructor validation test. Need to add a test that verifies: (1) Custom function is actually called during token refresh, (2) Function receives the refresh token as parameter, (3) Returned TokenRefreshResult is used to update tokens, (4) Works for both proactive and reactive refresh scenarios.

title: Update auth manager to be accessible even when auth not configured
description: According to the http-client spec, scenario 'No auth configured': When no TokenProvider is configured AND a developer accesses dio.auth, THEN the auth manager is still available but methods throw informative errors. Currently, the AcdcAuth extension throws a StateError when accessing dio.auth itself if no TokenProvider is configured (acdc_auth_manager.dart:207-210). The spec suggests dio.auth should return a manager instance, but calling methods (logout(), refreshNow(), clearCache()) should throw errors with message 'Authentication not configured. Use withTokenProvider() to enable.' This would provide better developer experience and clearer error messages.

title: Add test for clock skew handling using server Date header
description: According to the authentication spec, scenario 'Refresh response parsing with clock skew handling': When refresh endpoint returns success, the library should use the server Date header (if available) to calculate token expiry to prevent clock skew issues. Falls back to local time if Date header is absent. The implementation exists in auth_interceptor.dart:354-372 but there's no test verifying this behavior.

title: Add integration tests for app lifecycle during token refresh
description: According to the authentication spec, scenarios under 'App Lifecycle Handling': Need integration tests for: (1) App backgrounded during token refresh - refresh should continue if OS allows, (2) Network changes during refresh (WiFi to cellular) - refresh adapts or fails with AcdcNetworkException, (3) App killed during refresh - on relaunch, old tokens remain and next request triggers new refresh. These are complex integration scenarios that require platform-specific testing or mocking of app lifecycle events.

title: Write unit tests for AcdcAuthManager
description: Add tests for logout(), token revocation (best-effort), refreshNow(), clearCache(), and AcdcAuth extension. Cover error handling when TokenProvider throws exceptions during logout.

title: Refactor AuthInterceptor: Create AuthRequestHelper
description: Create lib/src/interceptors/auth_request_helper.dart with static helper methods to eliminate duplication (RequestOptions creation, token injection, header checking, retry flag management). Create tests and integrate into AuthInterceptor.

title: Add timeout test for queued requests during token refresh
description: The AuthInterceptor test for 'times out queued requests after timeout period' was removed because it was difficult to test. Need to add proper test with mocking or test infrastructure that can verify the timeout behavior when multiple requests are queued during a token refresh.

title: Review and reduce default HTTP timeouts to 5 seconds maximum
description: Current default timeout for HTTP operations (connect, send, receive) is set to 30 seconds in AcdcClientBuilder (line 567 in lib/src/builder/acdc_client_builder.dart). This should be reduced to a maximum of 5 seconds for better user experience and faster failure detection. Need to verify this change doesn't break existing tests and update documentation accordingly.

title: Add test for non-DioException error handling during refresh
description: The test 'handles unexpected exceptions during refresh gracefully' was simplified to just verify refresh was attempted. Need to verify that when a non-DioException is thrown during refresh (e.g., FormatException, generic Exception), the original 401 error is passed through to the handler, not the refresh exception.

title: Add test for no token rotation (retaining old refresh token)
description: According to the authentication spec, scenario 'No token rotation': When the refresh response does NOT include a new refresh_token field, only the access token should be updated and the existing refresh token should be retained. The setTokens() method should be called with the new access token and the EXISTING refresh token (not null). Currently only token rotation (new refresh token provided) is tested.

title: Add comprehensive exponential backoff test
description: The test 'handles server errors during refresh' was simplified to just verify refresh was called. Need to add proper test that: 1) simulates server 503 errors, 2) verifies backoff increases exponentially (1s, 2s, 4s, etc.), 3) verifies backoff is reset on success, 4) verifies backoff caps at 30s.

title: Refactor AuthInterceptor: Final cleanup and validation
description: Simplify _performTokenRefresh method, add retry Dio client reuse, remove remaining duplication. Run full test suite, verify code coverage, confirm line count reduction (447 → ~320 lines).

title: Decide if we need to upgrade dependencies
Implement SecureTokenProvider with flutter_secure_storage as default
description: Create a concrete TokenProvider implementation that uses flutter_secure_storage following Flutter security best practices. This should be configured as the default in AuthInterceptor if no custom TokenProvider is provided. Features needed: (1) Use flutter_secure_storage for iOS Keychain and Android Keystore integration, (2) Implement all TokenProvider methods with proper encryption, (3) Handle platform-specific security options (biometric auth, accessibility options), (4) Add comprehensive error handling for storage failures, (5) Update AcdcClientBuilder to use SecureTokenProvider by default when withTokenProvider is not called, (6) Add integration tests for secure storage, (7) Document security considerations and best practices in code comments.

title: Add integration tests or HTTP mocking for token refresh/revocation
description:
HTTP mocking approach partially implemented. Successfully refactored AuthInterceptor and AcdcAuthManager to accept optional Dio instances via dependency injection, making them testable.

Challenge: http_mock_adapter integration revealed that comprehensive OAuth/revocation testing requires either:
1. More sophisticated test infrastructure
2. Integration tests with a real OAuth server
3. Further refactoring to abstract HTTP layer

DI refactoring is complete and valuable. Remaining HTTP mocking tests need additional investigation and potentially a different mocking library or approach.

title: Implement exception equality for testing
description: According to the error-handling spec, scenario 'Exception equality for testing': When comparing two AcdcException instances in tests, they should be equal if: (1) Same exception type, (2) Same status code, (3) Same error message. This enables easy assertion in unit tests. Currently, exceptions don't override the == operator and hashCode, making test assertions more difficult.

title: Add test for expired refresh token clearing behavior
description: The test 'handles expired refresh token gracefully' was simplified to just verify request completion. Need to verify that when refresh token is expired, tokens ARE cleared (not just that it doesn't crash) and the correct auth exception is thrown or tokens are cleared.
